servingSurfaceInvestigation.question: Which app(s) actually reach HAUSKA_MAP_STYLE (hauska-map-style.js), as distinct from the two styles PR #336 already fixed (gis-map-paint.js's dark_all, consumed via a separate render path)?
servingSurfaceInvestigation.staticTrace: map-renderer.js's createMapRenderer() sets `style: HAUSKA_MAP_STYLE` at map construction (packages/map-renderer/src/map-renderer.js:239). FloatingMap.tsx imports createMapRenderer from map-renderer.js. Both property-explorer's ExplorerMap.tsx and command-center's LiveMapTile.tsx import FloatingMap from @hauska/map-renderer. Static tracing alone left it ambiguous whether gis-map-paint.js's dark_all (used inside gis-map-render.js, a DIFFERENT file) fully supersedes HAUSKA_MAP_STYLE at runtime via some later setStyle, or whether HAUSKA_MAP_STYLE is genuinely what mounts and stays.
servingSurfaceInvestigation.empiricalResolution: Fetched the LIVE, already-deployed smartsite.cloud bundle (from MAP-BASEMAP-KEY's own deploy, before touching anything) and grepped for the literal unkeyed string 'basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/'. It was present, verbatim, in the shipped production bundle -- proof this exact code path is live and reachable on PE today, resolving the ambiguity by evidence rather than further static tracing. dark_all and light_only_labels did NOT appear as literal concatenated strings in the same bundle (they are now built via a template literal with the style name passed as a separate argument), which is exactly the expected shape post-#336 and confirms the grep method distinguishes 'still hardcoded' from 'now dynamic' correctly.
servingSurfaceInvestigation.commandCenterUnresolved: Whether command-center independently bundles and deploys map-renderer (and therefore also carried this exact defect) was not checked this card -- named as an open item rather than assumed either way.

LESSON: When static tracing of a shared component's default prop leaves genuine ambiguity about which of several possible styles a production bundle actually ships, grep the ALREADY-LIVE deployed bundle for the literal string in question before spending more time on source-level tracing -- the deployed artifact is the ground truth the question is actually about.

A style built via a template literal (style name passed as a separate function argument) will not appear as one continuous string in a minified bundle even though the underlying URL is unchanged in shape -- a grep for the OLD hardcoded concatenated form correctly returns nothing post-fix, and this is a feature of the verification method, not a false negative to worry about.
